question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**earn**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence describes the milkmaid's aspirations for the money obtained through her work: "she started to imagine all the things she wished to do with the money she would 5_ from selling the milk."
 
• When you sell goods or services, you "**earn**" (कमाना) money as a result of that transaction.
 
• This word perfectly fits the context of gaining income from selling her milk.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

Complete Passage: *In a small village, lived a milkmaid (1) **who**__ sold the milk that she (2) __**got **__from her cows. She (3) __**would **__carry the milk in a big mud pitcher. One day, as she was walking (4) __**with **__the big pitcher full of milk on her head, she started to imagine all the things she wished to do with the money she would (5)__earn__ from selling the milk.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "catch"** (पकड़ना) – This means to seize or intercept, which does not apply to acquiring money from sales.
 
• **Option 2: "dig"** (खोदना) – This means to excavate earth, which is completely irrelevant.
 
• **Option 4: "throw"** (फेंकना) – This means to propel something through the air, which is the opposite of acquiring money.
